eval: () => { const el = document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot=session-row]')[1]; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: r.left + 90, clientY: r.top + 14 })); return true }

() => { const item = document.querySelector('[role=menuitem]'); if (!item) return { open: false }; const r = item.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = r.x + r.width / 2; const y = r.y + r.height / 2; const hit = document.elementFromPoint(x, y); return { open: true, rect: { x: r.x, y: r.y, w: r.width, h: r.height }, point: [x, y], hit: hit?.textContent?.trim() ?? null, hitTag: hit?.tagName ?? null } }
